decision.what: Whether to move the November launch to January

CEO.read: No direct competitor launches in the second half of the month.
CEO.tension: Against Risk, which wants more data first.

CFO.read: Launch-week media is 40% of the quarter's budget.
CFO.tension: Against the CRO, who wants to spend into the big week.

CRO.read: Store attention peaks the week before the holiday.
CRO.tension: Against the CFO on timing of spend.

CPO.read: No evidence on how many of our buyers also buy the big launch.

Legal.read: No contractual date with retail partners.
Legal.move: Keep date language about our own product.

Risk.read: The read rests on one calendar source.
Risk.move: Do not move the date on this alone.

reconciliation.course: Keep the date, move promotion earlier, and hold late-month spend until the survey is back.
reconciliation.resisted_by: The CRO, who loses some late-month reach.
